verses.en: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign.
verses.pt: No ano vinte e sete de Jeroboão, rei de Israel, começou a reinar Azarias, filho de Amazias, rei de Judá.
verses.en_web: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign.
verses.en_bbe: In the twenty-seventh year of the rule of Jeroboam, king of Israel, Azariah, son of Amaziah, became king of Judah.

verses.en: Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned two and fifty years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jecholiah of Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Quando começou a reinar tinha dezesseis anos, e reinou cinquenta e dois anos em Jerusalém; o nome de sua mãe foi Jecolias, de Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: He was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he was ruling in Jerusalem for fifty-two years; his mother's name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

verses.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah had done;
verses.pt: E fez o que era correto aos olhos do SENHOR, conforme todas as coisas que seu pai Amazias havia feito.
verses.en_web: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.
verses.en_bbe: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, as his father Amaziah had done.

verses.en: Save that the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places.
verses.pt: Contudo, os altos não foram tirados; pois o povo ainda sacrificava e queimava incenso nos altos.
verses.en_web: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.
verses.en_bbe: But he did not take away the high places, and the people still went on making offerings and burning them in the high places.

verses.en: And the LORD smote the king, so that he was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house. And Jotham the king’s son was over the house, judging the people of the land.
verses.pt: Mas o SENHOR feriu ao rei com lepra, e foi leproso até o dia de sua morte, e habitou em casa separada. Jotão, filho do rei tinha o cargo do palácio, governando o povo da terra.
verses.en_web: Yahweh struck the king, so that he was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house. Jotham, the king’s son was over the household, judging the people of the land.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord sent disease on the king and he became a leper, and to the day of his death he was living separately in his private house. And Jotham his son was over his house, judging the people of the land.

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.pt: Os demais dos feitos de Azarias, e todas as coisas que fez, não estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?
verses.en_web: Now the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.en_bbe: Now the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?

verses.en: So Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: Azarias descansou com seus pais, e sepultaram-no com seus pais na cidade de Davi; e Jotão, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
verses.en_web: Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city: and Jotham his son reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: And Azariah went to rest with his fathers and was put into the earth with his fathers in the town of David; and Jotham his son became king in his place.

verses.en: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months.
verses.pt: No ano trinta e oito de Azarias rei de Judá, reinou Zacarias, filho de Jeroboão, sobre Israel por seis meses.
verses.en_web: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah the son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria six months.
verses.en_bbe: In the thirty-eighth year of Azaliah, king of Judah, Zechariah, son of Jeroboam, was king over Israel for six months.

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his fathers had done: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
verses.pt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR, como seus ancestrais haviam feito; ele não se afastou dos pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, o que fez pecar a Israel.
verses.en_web: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as his fathers had done. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.
verses.en_bbe: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord, as his father had done, not turning away from the sin which Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, did and made Israel do.

verses.en: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: Contra ele se conspirou Salum, filho de Jabes, e o feriu em presença do seu povo; e o matou, e reinou em seu lugar.
verses.en_web: Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and struck him before the people, and killed him, and reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: And Shallum, the son of Jabesh, made a secret design against him, and, attacking him in Ibleam, put him to death and became king in his place.

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Zachariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.pt: Os demais dos feitos de Zacarias, eis que estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel.
verses.en_web: Now the rest of the acts of Zechariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Now the rest of the acts of Zechariah are recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel.

verses.en: This was the word of the LORD which he spake unto Jehu, saying, Thy sons shall sit on the throne of Israel unto the fourth generation. And so it came to pass.
verses.pt: E esta foi a palavra do SENHOR que havia falado a Jeú, dizendo: Teus filhos até a quarta geração se sentarão no trono de Israel. E assim foi.
verses.en_web: This was Yahweh’s word which he spoke to Jehu, saying, “Your sons to the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.” So it came to pass.
verses.en_bbe: This was what the Lord had said to Jehu, Your sons to the fourth generation will be kings of Israel. And so it came about.

verses.en: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah; and he reigned a full month in Samaria.
verses.pt: Salum, filho de Jabes, começou a reinar no ano trinta e nove de Uzias rei de Judá, e reinou pelo tempo de um mês em Samaria;
verses.en_web: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned for a month in Samaria.
verses.en_bbe: Shallum, the son of Jabesh, became king in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah, king of Judah; and he was ruling in Samaria for the space of one month.

verses.en: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to Samaria, and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: Pois subiu Menaém, filho de Gadi, de Tirsa, e veio a Samaria, e feriu Salum, filho de Jabes, em Samaria, e o matou, e reinou em seu lugar.
verses.en_web: Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, struck Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, killed him, and reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: Then Menahem, the son of Gadi, went up from Tirzah and came to Samaria, and attacking Shallum, son of Jabesh, in Samaria, put him to death and made himself king in his place.

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.pt: Os demais dos feitos de Salum, e sua conspiração com que conspirou, eis que estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel.
verses.en_web: Now the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Now the rest of the acts of Shallum, and the secret design which he made, are recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel.

verses.en: Then Menahem smote Tiphsah, and all that were therein, and the coasts thereof from Tirzah: because they opened not to him, therefore he smote it; and all the women therein that were with child he ripped up.
verses.pt: Então feriu Menaém a Tifsa, e a todos os que estavam nela, e também seus termos desde Tirsa; e feriu-a porque não lhe haviam aberto; e fendeu o ventre de todas as suas grávidas.
verses.en_web: Then Menahem attacked Tiphsah, and all who were in it, and its border areas, from Tirzah. He attacked it because they didn’t open their gates to him, and he ripped up all their women who were with child.
verses.en_bbe: Then Menahem sent destruction on Tappuah and all the people in it, and its limits, from Tirzah, because they would not let him come in; and he had all the women who were with child cut open.

verses.en: In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Israel, and reigned ten years in Samaria.
verses.pt: No ano trinta e nove de Azarias, rei de Judá, reinou Menaém, filho de Gadi, sobre Israel, por dez anos, em Samaria.
verses.en_web: In the thirty ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem the son of Gadi began to reign over Israel for ten years in Samaria.
verses.en_bbe: In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah, king of Judah, Menahem, the son of Gadi, became king over Israel, and was ruling in Samaria for ten years.

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
verses.pt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR; ele não se afastou em todo o seu tempo dos pecados de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, o que fez Israel pecar.
verses.en_web: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.
verses.en_bbe: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord; he did not keep himself from the sin which Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, did and made Israel do.

verses.en: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land: and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.
verses.pt: E veio Pul, rei da Assíria, à terra; e Menaém deu a Pul mil talentos de prata para lhe ajudasse a se firmar no reino.
verses.en_web: Pul the king of Assyria came against the land, and Menahem gave Pul one thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.
verses.en_bbe: In his day, Pul, the king of Assyria, came up against the land; and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver so that he might let him keep the kingdom.

verses.en: And Menahem exacted the money of Israel, even of all the mighty men of wealth, of each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and stayed not there in the land.
verses.pt: E impôs Menaém este dinheiro sobre Israel, sobre todos os poderosos e ricos: de cada um cinquenta siclos de prata, para dar ao rei da Assíria, e o rei da Assíria voltou, e não ficou ali na terra.
verses.en_web: Menahem exacted the money from Israel, even from all the mighty men of wealth, from each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and didn’t stay there in the land.
verses.en_bbe: And Menahem got the money from Israel, from all the men of wealth, fifty silver shekels from every man, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria went back without stopping in the land.

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.pt: Os demais dos feitos de Menaém, e todas as coisas que fez, acaso não estão escritas no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel?
verses.en_web: Now the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.en_bbe: Now the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?

verses.en: And Menahem slept with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: Menaém descansou com seus pais, e reinou em seu lugar seu filho Pecaías.
verses.en_web: Menahem slept with his fathers, and Pekahiah his son reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: And Menahem went to rest with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son became king in his place.

verses.en: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned two years.
verses.pt: No ano cinquenta de Azarias rei de Judá, reinou Pecaías filho de Menaém sobre Israel em Samaria, dois anos.
verses.en_web: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria for two years.
verses.en_bbe: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah, the son of Menahem, became king over Israel in Samaria, ruling for two years.

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
verses.pt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR: não se separou dos pecados de Jeroboão filho de Nebate, o que fez Israel pecar.
verses.en_web: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.
verses.en_bbe: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, not turning from the sin which Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, did and made Israel do.

verses.en: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his room.
verses.pt: E conspirou contra ele Peca filho de Remalias, capitão seu, e feriu-o em Samaria, no palácio da casa real, em companhia de Argobe e de Arié, e com cinquenta homens dos filhos dos gileaditas; e o matou, e reinou em seu lugar.
verses.en_web: Pekah the son of Remaliah, his captain, conspired against him and attacked him in Samaria, in the fortress of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh; and with him were fifty men of the Gileadites. He killed him, and reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: And Pekah, the son of Remaliah, his captain, made a secret design against him, attacking him in the king's great house in Samaria; and with him were fifty men of Gilead; and he put him to death and became king in his place.

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.pt: Os demais dos feitos de Pecaías, e todas as coisas que fez, eis que estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel.
verses.en_web: Now the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Now the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all he did, are recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel.

verses.en: In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned twenty years.
verses.pt: No ano cinquenta e dois de Azarias rei de Judá, reinou Peca, filho de Remalias sobre Israel em Samaria; e reinou vinte anos.
verses.en_web: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria for twenty years.
verses.en_bbe: In the fifty-second year of Azariah, king of Judah, Pekah, the son of Remaliah, became king over Israel in Samaria, ruling for twenty years.

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
verses.pt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR; não se separou dos pecados de Jeroboão filho de Nebate, o que fez pecar a Israel.
verses.en_web: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.
verses.en_bbe: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, not turning from the sin which Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, did and made Israel do.

verses.en: In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and took Ijon, and Abel-beth-maachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and carried them captive to Assyria.
verses.pt: Nos dias de Peca rei de Israel, veio Tiglate-Pileser rei dos assírios, e tomou a Ijom, Abel-Bete-Maaca, e Janoa, e Quedes, e Hazor, e Gileade, e Galileia, e toda a terra de Naftali; e transportou-os à Assíria.
verses.en_web: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali; and he carried them captive to Assyria.
verses.en_bbe: In the days of Pekah, king of Israel, Tiglath-pileser, king of Assyria, came and took Ijon and Abel-beth-maacah and Janoah and Kedesh and Hazor and Gilead and Galilee and all the land of Naphtali; and he took the people away to Assyria.

verses.en: And Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and smote him, and slew him, and reigned in his stead, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.
verses.pt: E Oseias filho de Elá fez conspiração contra Peca filho de Remalias, e feriu-o, e o matou, e reinou em seu lugar, aos vinte anos de Jotão filho de Uzias.
verses.en_web: Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, attacked him, killed him, and reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.
verses.en_bbe: And Hoshea, the son of Elah, made a secret design against Pekah, the son of Remaliah, and, attacking him, put him to death and became king in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham, the son of Uzziah.

verses.en: And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.pt: Os demais dos feitos de Peca, e tudo o que fez, eis que está escrito no livro das crônicas dos reis de Israel.
verses.en_web: Now the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Now the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all he did, are recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel.

verses.en: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign.
verses.pt: No segundo ano de Peca filho de Remalias rei de Israel, começou a reinar Jotão filho de Uzias rei de Judá.
verses.en_web: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign.
verses.en_bbe: In the second year of Pekah, the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, Jotham, the son of Uzziah, became king of Judah.

verses.en: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.
verses.pt: Quando começou a reinar era de vinte e cinco anos, e reinou dezesseis anos em Jerusalém. O nome de sua mãe foi Jerusa filha de Zadoque.
verses.en_web: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerusha the daughter of Zadok.
verses.en_bbe: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he was ruling for sixteen years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.

verses.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD: he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
verses.pt: E ele fez o que era correto aos olhos do SENHOR; fez conforme todas as coisas que havia feito seu pai Uzias.
verses.en_web: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes. He did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
verses.en_bbe: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, as his father Uzziah had done.

verses.en: Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places. He built the higher gate of the house of the LORD.
verses.pt: Com tudo isso os altos não foram tirados; que o povo sacrificava ainda, e queimava incenso nos altos. Edificou ele a porta mais alta da casa do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places. He built the upper gate of Yahweh’s house.
verses.en_bbe: But he did not take away the high places, and the people still went on making offerings and burning them in the high places. He was the builder of the higher doorway of the house of the Lord.

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.pt: Os demais dos feitos de Jotão, e todas as coisas que fez, não estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?
verses.en_web: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.en_bbe: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?

verses.en: In those days the LORD began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.
verses.pt: Naquele tempo começou o SENHOR a enviar contra Judá a Resim rei da Síria, e a Peca filho de Remalias.
verses.en_web: In those days, Yahweh began to send Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah against Judah.
verses.en_bbe: In those days the Lord first sent against Judah, Rezin, the king of Aram, and Pekah, the son of Remaliah.

verses.en: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: E descansou Jotão com seus pais, e foi sepultado com seus pais na cidade de Davi seu pai; e reinou em seu lugar Acaz seu filho.
verses.en_web: Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city, and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: And Jotham went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth in the town of David his father; and Ahaz his son became king in his place.
